description: This file defines a LightningJS component named NotesList that displays a header with a search label and query, an add button, and a list of notes with their titles and previews. It handles emitting events for note selection, creation, and search query updates.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying and interacting with a list of notes, including search and add functionalities.

methods.name: $emitSelect
methods.description: Emits a 'select' event with the given note ID when a note is clicked.

methods.name: $emitCreate
methods.description: Emits a 'create' event when the add button is pressed.

methods.name: $preview
methods.description: Returns a truncated preview of the note's content, replacing newlines with spaces and appending an ellipsis if longer than 50 characters.

methods.name: $itemColor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a note item based on whether it is selected.

methods.name: $titleColor
methods.description: Determines the text color of the note title based on selection.
